verses.en: And it came to pass, when he had made an end of speaking unto Saul, that the soul of Jonathan was knit with the soul of David, and Jonathan loved him as his own soul.
verses.pt: E assim que ele acabou de falar com Saul, a alma de Jônatas se apegou à de Davi, e Jônatas o amou como à sua alma.
verses.en_web: When he had finished speaking to Saul, the soul of Jonathan was knit with the soul of David, and Jonathan loved him as his own soul.
verses.en_bbe: Now after David's talk with Saul was ended, the soul of Jonathan was joined with the soul of David, and David became as dear to him as his very life.

verses.en: And Saul took him that day, and would let him go no more home to his father’s house.
verses.pt: E Saul o tomou naquele dia, e não o deixou voltar à casa de seu pai.
verses.en_web: Saul took him that day, and would let him go no more home to his father’s house.
verses.en_bbe: And that day Saul took David and would not let him go back to his father's house.

verses.en: Then Jonathan and David made a covenant, because he loved him as his own soul.
verses.pt: E fizeram aliança Jônatas e Davi, porque ele lhe amava como a sua alma.
verses.en_web: Then Jonathan and David made a covenant, because he loved him as his own soul.
verses.en_bbe: Then Jonathan and David made an agreement together, because of Jonathan's love for David.

verses.en: And Jonathan stripped himself of the robe that was upon him, and gave it to David, and his garments, even to his sword, and to his bow, and to his girdle.
verses.pt: E Jônatas despiu a roupa que tinha sobre si, e deu-a a Davi, e outras roupas suas, até sua espada, e seu arco, e seu cinto.
verses.en_web: Jonathan stripped himself of the robe that was on him, and gave it to David, and his clothing, even including his sword, his bow, and his sash.
verses.en_bbe: And Jonathan took off the robe he had on and gave it to David, with all his military dress, even to his sword and his bow and the band round his body.

verses.en: And David went out whithersoever Saul sent him, and behaved himself wisely: and Saul set him over the men of war, and he was accepted in the sight of all the people, and also in the sight of Saul’s servants.
verses.pt: E Davi saía para onde quer que Saul o enviasse, e portava-se prudentemente. Fê-lo, portanto, Saul capitão da gente de guerra, e era aceito aos olhos de todo o povo, e nos olhos dos criados de Saul.
verses.en_web: David went out wherever Saul sent him, and behaved himself wisely; and Saul set him over the men of war. It was good in the sight of all the people, and also in the sight of Saul’s servants.
verses.en_bbe: And David went wherever Saul sent him, and did wisely: and Saul put him at the head of his men of war, and this was pleasing to all the people as well as to Saul's servants.

verses.en: And it came to pass as they came, when David was returned from the slaughter of the Philistine, that the women came out of all cities of Israel, singing and dancing, to meet king Saul, with tabrets, with joy, and with instruments of musick.
verses.pt: E aconteceu que quando voltavam eles, quando Davi voltou de matar ao filisteu, saíram as mulheres de todas as cidades de Israel cantando, e com danças, com tamboris, e com alegrias e adufes, a receber ao rei Saul.
verses.en_web: As they came, when David returned from the slaughter of the Philistine, the women came out of all the cities of Israel, singing and dancing, to meet king Saul, with tambourines, with joy, and with instruments of music.
verses.en_bbe: Now on their way, when David came back after the destruction of the Philistine, the women came out of all the towns of Israel, with songs and dances, meeting David with melody and joy and instruments of music.

verses.en: And the women answered one another as they played, and said, Saul hath slain his thousands, and David his ten thousands.
verses.pt: E cantavam as mulheres que dançavam, e diziam: Saul feriu seus milhares, E Davi seus dez milhares.
verses.en_web: The women sang to one another as they played, and said, “Saul has slain his thousands, and David his ten thousands.”
verses.en_bbe: And the women, answering one another in their song, said, Saul has put to death his thousands and David his tens of thousands.

verses.en: And Saul was very wroth, and the saying displeased him; and he said, They have ascribed unto David ten thousands, and to me they have ascribed but thousands: and what can he have more but the kingdom?
verses.pt: E irou-se Saul em grande maneira, e desagradou esta palavra em seus olhos, e disse: A Davi deram dez milhares, e a mim milhares; não lhe falta mais que o reino.
verses.en_web: Saul was very angry, and this saying displeased him. He said, “They have ascribed to David ten thousands, and to me they have ascribed only thousands. What can he have more but the kingdom?”
verses.en_bbe: And Saul was very angry and this saying was unpleasing to him; and he said, They have given David credit for tens of thousands, and to me for only thousands: what more is there for him but the kingdom?

verses.en: And Saul eyed David from that day and forward.
verses.pt: E desde aquele dia Saul olhou com desconfiança a Davi.
verses.en_web: Saul watched David from that day and forward.
verses.en_bbe: And from that day Saul was looking with envy on David.

verses.en: And it came to pass on the morrow, that the evil spirit from God came upon Saul, and he prophesied in the midst of the house: and David played with his hand, as at other times: and there was a javelin in Saul’s hand.
verses.pt: Outro dia aconteceu que o espírito mau da parte de Deus tomou a Saul, e mostrava-se em sua casa com trejeitos de profeta: e Davi tocava com sua mão como os outros dias; e estava uma lança à mão de Saul.
verses.en_web: On the next day, an evil spirit from God came mightily on Saul, and he prophesied in the middle of the house. David played with his hand, as he did day by day. Saul had his spear in his hand;
verses.en_bbe: Now on the day after, an evil spirit from God came on Saul with great force and he was acting like a prophet among the men of his house, while David was making music for him, as he did day by day: and Saul had his spear in his hand.

verses.en: And Saul cast the javelin; for he said, I will smite David even to the wall with it. And David avoided out of his presence twice.
verses.pt: E lançou Saul a lança, dizendo: Encravarei a Davi na parede. E duas vezes se afastou dele Davi.
verses.en_web: and Saul threw the spear, for he said, “I will pin David even to the wall!” David escaped from his presence twice.
verses.en_bbe: And Saul, balancing the spear in his hand, said, I will give David a blow, pinning him to the wall. And David got away from him twice.

verses.en: And Saul was afraid of David, because the LORD was with him, and was departed from Saul.
verses.pt: Mas Saul se temia de Davi porquanto o SENHOR era com ele, e havia se afastado de Saul.
verses.en_web: Saul was afraid of David, because Yahweh was with him, and had departed from Saul.
verses.en_bbe: And Saul went in fear of David, because the Lord was with David and had gone away from Saul.

verses.en: Therefore Saul removed him from him, and made him his captain over a thousand; and he went out and came in before the people.
verses.pt: Afastou-o, pois, Saul de si, e fez-lhe capitão de mil; e saía e entrava diante do povo.
verses.en_web: Therefore Saul removed him from his presence, and made him his captain over a thousand; and he went out and came in before the people.
verses.en_bbe: So Saul sent him away, and made him a captain over a thousand; and he went about his business before the people.

verses.en: And David behaved himself wisely in all his ways; and the LORD was with him.
verses.pt: E Davi se conduzia prudentemente em todos seus negócios, e o SENHOR era com ele.
verses.en_web: David behaved himself wisely in all his ways; and Yahweh was with him.
verses.en_bbe: And in all his undertakings David did wisely; and the Lord was with him.

verses.en: Wherefore when Saul saw that he behaved himself very wisely, he was afraid of him.
verses.pt: E vendo Saul que se portava tão prudentemente, temia-se dele.
verses.en_web: When Saul saw that he behaved himself very wisely, he stood in awe of him.
verses.en_bbe: And when Saul saw how wisely he did, he was in fear of him.

verses.en: But all Israel and Judah loved David, because he went out and came in before them.
verses.pt: Mas todos os de Israel e Judá amavam a Davi, porque ele saía e entrava diante deles.
verses.en_web: But all Israel and Judah loved David; for he went out and came in before them.
verses.en_bbe: But David was loved by all Israel and Judah, for he went out and came in before them.

verses.en: And Saul said to David, Behold my elder daughter Merab, her will I give thee to wife: only be thou valiant for me, and fight the LORD’S battles. For Saul said, Let not mine hand be upon him, but let the hand of the Philistines be upon him.
verses.pt: E disse Saul a Davi: Eis que eu te darei a Merabe minha filha maior por mulher: somente que me sejas homem valente, e faças as guerras do SENHOR. Mas Saul dizia: Não será minha mão contra ele, mas a mão dos filisteus será contra ele.
verses.en_web: Saul said to David, “Behold, my elder daughter Merab, I will give her to you as wife. Only be valiant for me, and fight Yahweh’s battles.” For Saul said, “Don’t let my hand be on him, but let the hand of the Philistines be on him.”
verses.en_bbe: And Saul said to David, Here is my oldest daughter Merab, whom I will give you for your wife: only be strong for me, fighting in the Lord's wars. For Saul said, Let it not be through me that his fate comes to him, but through the Philistines.

verses.en: And David said unto Saul, Who am I? and what is my life, or my father’s family in Israel, that I should be son in law to the king?
verses.pt: E Davi respondeu a Saul: Quem sou eu, ou que é minha vida, ou a família de meu pai em Israel, para ser genro do rei?
verses.en_web: David said to Saul, “Who am I, and what is my life, or my father’s family in Israel, that I should be son-in-law to the king?”
verses.en_bbe: And David said to Saul, Who am I, and what is my father's family in Israel, that I am to be son-in-law to the king?

verses.en: But it came to pass at the time when Merab Saul’s daughter should have been given to David, that she was given unto Adriel the Meholathite to wife.
verses.pt: E vindo o tempo em que Merabe, filha de Saul, se havia de dar a Davi, foi dada por mulher a Adriel meolatita.
verses.en_web: But at the time when Merab, Saul’s daughter, should have been given to David, she was given to Adriel the Meholathite as wife.
verses.en_bbe: But when the time came to give Merab, Saul's daughter, to David, she was given to Adriel of Meholath.

verses.en: And Michal Saul’s daughter loved David: and they told Saul, and the thing pleased him.
verses.pt: Mas Mical a outra filha de Saul amava a Davi; e foi dito a Saul, o qual foi conveniente em seus olhos.
verses.en_web: Michal, Saul’s daughter, loved David; and they told Saul, and the thing pleased him.
verses.en_bbe: And Saul's daughter Michal was in love with David: and Saul had word of it and was pleased.

verses.en: And Saul said, I will give him her, that she may be a snare to him, and that the hand of the Philistines may be against him. Wherefore Saul said to David, Thou shalt this day be my son in law in the one of the twain.
verses.pt: E Saul disse: Eu a darei a ele, para que lhe seja por armadilha, e para que a mão dos filisteus seja contra ele. Disse, pois, Saul a Davi: Com a outra serás meu genro hoje.
verses.en_web: Saul said, I will give her to him, that she may be a snare to him, and that the hand of the Philistines may be against him. Therefore Saul said to David, “You shall today be my son-in-law a second time.”
verses.en_bbe: And Saul said, I will give her to him, so that she may be a cause of danger to him, and so that the hands of the Philistines may be against him. So Saul said to David, Today you are to become my son-in-law for the second time.

verses.en: And Saul commanded his servants, saying, Commune with David secretly, and say, Behold, the king hath delight in thee, and all his servants love thee: now therefore be the king’s son in law.
verses.pt: E mandou Saul a seus criados: Falai em secreto a Davi, dizendo-lhe: Eis que, o rei te ama, e todos seus criados te querem bem; sê, pois, genro do rei.
verses.en_web: Saul commanded his servants, “Talk with David secretly, and say, ‘Behold, the king has delight in you, and all his servants love you. Now therefore be the king’s son-in-law.’”
verses.en_bbe: And Saul gave his servants orders saying, Have talk with David secretly and say to him, See how the king has delight in you, and how you are loved by all his servants: then be the king's son-in-law.

verses.en: And Saul’s servants spake those words in the ears of David. And David said, Seemeth it to you a light thing to be a king’s son in law, seeing that I am a poor man, and lightly esteemed?
verses.pt: E os criados de Saul falaram estas palavras aos ouvidos de Davi. E Davi disse: Parece-vos que é pouco ser genro do rei, sendo eu um homem pobre e de nenhuma estima?
verses.en_web: Saul’s servants spoke those words in the ears of David. David said, “Does it seem to you a light thing to be the king’s son-in-law, since I am a poor man, and little known?”
verses.en_bbe: And Saul's servants said these things to David. And David said, Does it seem to you a small thing to be the king's son-in-law, seeing that I am a poor man, of no great name?

verses.en: And the servants of Saul told him, saying, On this manner spake David.
verses.pt: E os criados de Saul lhe deram a resposta dizendo: Tais palavras disse Davi.
verses.en_web: The servants of Saul told him, saying, “David spoke like this.”
verses.en_bbe: And the servants of Saul gave him an account of what David had said.

verses.en: And Saul said, Thus shall ye say to David, The king desireth not any dowry, but an hundred foreskins of the Philistines, to be avenged of the king’s enemies. But Saul thought to make David fall by the hand of the Philistines.
verses.pt: E Saul disse: Dizei assim a Davi: Não está o contentamento do rei no dote, mas sim em cem prepúcios de filisteus, para que seja tomada vingança dos inimigos do rei. Mas Saul pensava lançar a Davi em mãos dos filisteus.
verses.en_web: Saul said, “Tell David, ‘The king desires no dowry except one hundred foreskins of the Philistines, to be avenged of the king’s enemies.’” Now Saul thought he would make David fall by the hand of the Philistines.
verses.en_bbe: And Saul said, Then say to David, The king has no desire for any bride-price, but only for the private parts of a hundred Philistines so that the king may get the better of his haters. But it was in Saul's mind that David might come to his end by the hands of the Philistines.

verses.en: And when his servants told David these words, it pleased David well to be the king’s son in law: and the days were not expired.
verses.pt: E quando seus criados declararam a Davi estas palavras, foi conveniente a coisa nos olhos de Davi, para ser genro do rei. E quando o prazo não era ainda cumprido,
verses.en_web: When his servants told David these words, it pleased David well to be the king’s son-in-law. Before the deadline,
verses.en_bbe: And when his servants said these words to David, he was well pleased to be the son-in-law of the king. And the days were still not past.

verses.en: Wherefore David arose and went, he and his men, and slew of the Philistines two hundred men; and David brought their foreskins, and they gave them in full tale to the king, that he might be the king’s son in law. And Saul gave him Michal his daughter to wife.
verses.pt: Levantou-se Davi, e partiu-se com sua gente, e feriu duzentos homens dos filisteus; e trouxe Davi os prepúcios deles, e entregaram-nos todos ao rei, para que ele fosse feito genro do rei. E Saul lhe deu a sua filha Mical por mulher.
verses.en_web: David arose and went, he and his men, and killed two hundred men of the Philistines. Then David brought their foreskins, and they gave them in full number to the king, that he might be the king’s son-in-law. Then Saul gave him Michal his daughter as wife.
verses.en_bbe: So David and his men got up and went, and put to death two hundred of the Philistines; and David took their private parts and gave the full number of them to the king, so that he might be the king's son-in-law. And Saul gave him his daughter Michal for his wife.

verses.en: And Saul saw and knew that the LORD was with David, and that Michal Saul’s daughter loved him.
verses.pt: Porém Saul, vendo e considerando que o SENHOR era com Davi, e que sua filha Mical o amava,
verses.en_web: Saul saw and knew that Yahweh was with David; and Michal, Saul’s daughter, loved him.
verses.en_bbe: And it was clear to Saul that the Lord was with David; and he was loved by all Israel.

verses.en: And Saul was yet the more afraid of David; and Saul became David’s enemy continually.
verses.pt: Temeu-se mais de Davi; e foi Saul inimigo de Davi todos os dias.
verses.en_web: Saul was even more afraid of David; and Saul was David’s enemy continually.
verses.en_bbe: And Saul's fear of David became all the greater, and he went on hating him, day by day.

verses.en: Then the princes of the Philistines went forth: and it came to pass, after they went forth, that David behaved himself more wisely than all the servants of Saul; so that his name was much set by.
verses.pt: E saíam os príncipes dos filisteus; e quando eles saíam, portava-se Davi mais prudentemente que todos os servos de Saul: e era seu nome muito ilustre.
verses.en_web: Then the princes of the Philistines went out; and as often as they went out, David behaved himself more wisely than all the servants of Saul, so that his name was highly esteemed.
verses.en_bbe: Then the rulers of the Philistines went out to war: and whenever they went out, David did more wisely than all the other servants of Saul, so that his name became greatly honoured.
